answer: Each agent identity is minted by an SGX enclave with a TPM, which emits a zero-knowledge attestation binding code, hardware key, and nonce to the ripple state tree; plume is the hash anchor and pigment is the consensus contract verifying membership. Forging requires compromising distinct physical enclaves or reproducing sealed keys and passing attestation. A quadratic bonding curve O(N^2) prices identities, while equivocation triggers irreversible collateral slashing.
